name: Haresfield Beacon and the escarpment edge

editorial.summary: Placeholder record on the Cotswold escarpment north-west of Stroud, present to exercise the schema.
editorial.character: This record exists so that the site, the validator, and the index builder have something to operate on before the first real survey runs. The geometry is a hand-drawn ring of seven points and does not follow any path on the ground. Nothing here should be read as a description of a walk, and the validator refuses to publish it for exactly that reason.
editorial.conditions: Not applicable. Replace this record with the output of survey.py and author.py before the site goes anywhere public.
editorial.practical: Not applicable. The amenities block is empty rather than plausible, which is the intended failure mode: an empty field is honest, an invented field is not.
editorial.caveats: The entire record is a placeholder. Access is recorded as unknown across the whole length because no survey has been run. Do not walk this.

confidence.basis: No survey has been run. The geometry is hand-drawn and does not correspond to a mapped route, so the probability of following it as described is approximately zero.
